en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5752 - In the narration of Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Riʾab and Khaṭṭab Abu Muhammad Al-Hamdani from Ṭirbal from Abu Jafar Imam Al-Baqir (as), he said: "
A woman does not inherit from what her husband leaves behind of villages, houses, weapons, or animals. However, she inherits from money, slaves, clothing, and household items that he leaves behind."
Imam (as) then said: "The dismantled parts of palm trunks, reeds, and doors are evaluated, and she is given her rightful share from that."
